'''Micro-anechoic Coating''' was a paper-thin material used for completely soundproofing a room.

Micro-anechoic Coating was developed for the [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], during the early stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
